sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "trans"."account_id" AS e, "account"."frequency" AS g, AVG((CASE WHEN "trans"."type" IN ('PRIJEM') THEN "trans"."amount" WHEN "trans"."type" IN ('VYDAJ') THEN -"trans"."amount" END)) AS m1, AVG("trans"."balance") AS m2 FROM "trans" JOIN "account" ON "account"."account_id" = "trans"."account_id"  GROUP BY "trans"."account_id", "account"."frequency"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: net transaction amount: 'PRIJEM' counted positive (in), 'VYDAJ' negative (out) by the documented direction; 'VYBER' undocumented and left out
